_readme: Committed alt-source allowlist for kb-fact-check. Each kb id maps to trusted, verified sources. `plan` merges these into tmp/kb-fact-check/index.json; `fetch` pulls them. Sources are NEVER auto-discovered — a URL enters only here or via `alt add`. tier: 1 = vendor/primary/CC-open; 2 = practitioner canon / reference, cite-only; 3 = single blog. All URLs below were probed live (HTTP 200) before commit. Wikipedia is fetched separately by the resolver, not listed here.
